cohort: Newborns with a gestational age greater than 34 weeks in Brazil
finding: Late preterm infants, previous maternal obstetric risks and maternal age contributed to the higher needs of PPV and use of O2 in the delivery room.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery, particularly pre-labor cesarean section, was associated with an increased need for positive pressure ventilation (PPV) and supplemental oxygen in newborns.
